Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units for all activity rows in assay CHEMBL4649973. Join activities to molecule_dictionary and compound_structures (inner join) to ensure canonical_smiles is present. Filter to exact measurements where standard_relation is '=' and standard_value is not null. Return every qualifying activity row without deduplication. Sort by canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units.
